params.body:
## Why

After a chassis (VIN) lookup the vehicle sheet reloaded to
`own-vehicles/create?v=<id>&tab=general&vin=ok`, and the sheet showed "data fetched from the
chassis number" for as long as that flag stayed in the address bar. Every refresh, every
back-button, every shared link repeated the claim, while nothing had been fetched. A one-off
signal had been parked in a place that outlives the event.

The flag existed for a reason, and the reason turned out to be a bug: **a message flashed into
the session never survived its own request**, so `->with('message')` reached no page anywhere in
the app. `StartSession` was registered twice — once in the global middleware stack and once in
the `web` group. Each instance saves the session when it is done, and saving ages the flash data
(`_flash.new` -> `_flash.old` -> gone). Two saves in one request wiped whatever that request had
just flashed. The second instance also ran *before* `EncryptCookies` (which lives in the `web`
group), so it read the encrypted cookie value as a session id and started a stray session on
every request. Removing it from the global stack is the fix; the `web` group has had it all
along, and nothing outside that group (`api`, `webhook`) touches the session.

## What

- `app/Http/Kernel.php`: one `StartSession`, in the `web` group. The comment carries the reason.
- `OwnStockController::createFromVIN()` flashes the outcome instead of letting the client append
  a flag: `vin_lookup_done` when everything came back, and a new `vin_lookup_partial` when the
  lookup went through but reported errors — "fetched" would have been a lie there, and it was
  exactly what the old `vin=ok` said. The failing branch (HTTP 400/422) flashes nothing: no
  reload follows it, the modal shows the reason itself, and a flash would surface later on an
  unrelated page.
- `resources/views/layouts/toast.blade.php` is the one place that turns `session('message')` into
  `ui.notify(...)`. `layouts/message.blade.php` now includes it, so every existing caller keeps
  working; pages with their own `@section('scripts')` (the classic create and edit) include it
  directly, which they could not do before without overwriting that section.
- Both redirects drop `&vin=ok`; the Livewire sheet no longer reads `request()->query('vin')`. An
  old link with `?vin=ok` is just an unused parameter: no message, no error.
- The classic create page crashed on the very URL this flow produced: `step: {{ request()->get('tab') - 1 }}`
  with `tab=general` is a TypeError on PHP 8. A non-numeric tab now counts as the first step.
- `vin_lookup_partial` added in nl, fr, de, en and es.

## Both entry points

The classic create/edit pages and the Livewire sheet (`vehicle_form_preview.blade.php` +
`App\Livewire\VehicleForm`) now use the same path: the controller flashes, the reload shows the
toast once. The lookup flow itself is untouched — it still posts, still reloads, and the
`case 'vin':` branches that toggle `.vinOnly` are as they were.

## Checked

- `VinLookupMessageTest`: the lookup flashes its outcome; a partial lookup does not claim
  everything was fetched; the sheet (Livewire and classic) shows the message once and is silent
  on the next load; `?vin=ok` produces nothing.
- `php artisan view:cache` + `php -l` over the compiled views.
- `php artisan test` on the full suite.
params.title: Vehicle sheet: the VIN message shows once, not on every refresh
